Name: Potiphar
Summary: Potiphar was an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard, who bought Joseph as a slave and put him in charge of his whole house.
KeyStory: Potiphar saw that the LORD was with Joseph and made him overseer — until his wife's false accusation sent Joseph to prison.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Potiphar's Wife
LifeLesson: Favor can turn quickly, but God's presence with Joseph did not depend on his position.
